jobs.description:
About the role

This SAP position centers on production-driven processes in a manufacturing setting, with a clear focus on SAP PE, QM and PPDS.

You take the lead in and support end-to-end SAP implementations, covering fit-gap analysis, system configuration, functional design documentation, training, UAT, data gathering and migration, go-live support, and final documentation. In this role, you work closely with logistics, controlling, procurement and other business domains to secure smooth SAP integration across domains.

You collaborate proactively with cross-functional stakeholders and production team members to shape detailed, scalable and sustainable processes. This assignment calls for someone who can grasp complex business flows, challenge stakeholders to clarify their real needs, and translate those requirements into structured SAP solutions in both template-based and custom-built environments.

You also support business users through clear communication, maintain alignment between domains, and contribute to successful deployment activities in an international environment.

Key responsibilities

• Lead and support SAP delivery across the full implementation lifecycle, from analysis through go-live and documentation.
• Design and optimize production-related SAP processes within a manufacturing environment.
• Translate business needs into robust functional solutions across connected SAP domains.
• Work with stakeholders across logistics, controlling, procurement and production to ensure process consistency and integration.
• Support deployment activities, including additional travel where needed around go-live periods.
Project scope

• Production Execution (PE): strong expertise in SAP PE processes in a manufacturing context, including shop floor integration and execution flows.
• Quality Management (QM): solid experience in SAP QM, ideally combined with integration with Labvantage or a comparable LIMS platform.
• PPDS: good understanding of Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling, with the ability to connect planning and execution processes.
• Experience with EWM integration is an advantage.
• Experience in greenfield implementations is a plus.
Work environment

You work in an international, multicultural setting with regular on-site presence in Hoboken and travel when required, including possible additional travel during go-live phases.

• Proven experience with end-to-end SAP implementations.
• Strong expertise in SAP integration across domains, including logistics, controlling and procurement.
• Hands-on experience with SAP PE, QM and PPDS in a manufacturing company.
• PPDS knowledge is preferred but not mandatory.
• Familiarity with integration with Labvantage or a similar LIMS platform, and preferably EWM.
• Ability to debug and troubleshoot SAP issues is a plus.
• You communicate clearly, in a structured and business-oriented way, and can explain complex solutions in a simple manner to stakeholders.
• You are comfortable challenging the business to uncover the underlying requirements.
• You collaborate effectively with both business stakeholders and technical colleagues and build strong working relationships.
• You demonstrate a proactive mindset, resilience under pressure and flexibility when priorities shift.
• You are willing to be on site in Hoboken every week.
• You are fluent in English.
• Good French is required to support project activities for the Grenoble deployment.
• Polish is a plus.
• A bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
• SAP certification is an asset, but hands-on experience is considered more important.

Handle deposits, remittances and related transactions.

Assist with the processing of customer data, accounts and related administrative tasks.

Carry out relevant tasks and document processing in accordance with the company's internal regulations.

Other duties related to the role.
 
Qualifications:

A bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification is required; any subject area is acceptable. Candidates with a background in finance, accounting or business administration, or with work experience in the financial sector, are particularly welcome.

Language Skills:

Good spoken and written communication skills in both Mandarin and English; candidates with French language skills are particularly welcome.

Work Eligibility:

Must be legally authorised to work in Belgium and be able to provide relevant proof upon appointment.

Computer Skills:

Proficient in word processing software such as Word, Excel and PowerPoint; good Mandarin typing skills.

Personal Attributes:

Meticulous, responsible, with strong numerical aptitude and document handling skills; able to strictly adhere to work processes and relevant regulations.

Other Requirements:

Experience in finance, banking, accountancy or related administrative roles is particularly desirable.

jobs.occupation: Handyman / general facilities technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician with solid electrical knowledge and a passion for maintenance, repairs, and problem-solving? Do you enjoy having variety in your work and being the go-to person for all technical issues? And are you already living in Belgium?

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician or handyman to help maintain the buildings, warehouse facilities, technical installations and outdoor areas. A very varied job that combines electrical maintenance, facility maintenance, repairs, troubleshooting and general handyman tasks. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you're responsible for a wide range of maintenance and repair activities across the different sites of the company. You and the rest of the technical team use your technical skills to ensure the operations run safely and efficiently.

Your key duties:

• Perform electrical maintenance and repairs
• Carry out minor repairs to plumbing, storage racks, equipment...
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers

Your profile:

• Good knowledge of electrical systems and installations
• Basic knowledge of plumbing, mechanics, building maintenance, or general technical repairs
• Experience as a maintenance technician, handyman, facilities technician, general maintenance worker...
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English
 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

For our client, a well-known company in the VEURNE region, we are looking for a RENOVATION WORKER.

Do you enjoy variety in your job and love renovating? We've got you covered!

Your day as a RENOVATION WORKER in the Veurne region will look like this:

  • Together with your colleagues, you carry out demolition work;
  • You lay ceramic and natural stone tiles;
  • You ensure that masonry and cementing work is carried out correctly;
  • You make sure that stability work is not overlooked;
  • You ensure that the entire renovation is completed with high quality.



As a RENOVATION WORKER in VEURNE, you meet the following requirements:

  • A telehandler certificate is a plus!
  • You have extensive experience as a renovation worker;
  • You have a category B driving license and can easily commute to the company;
  • You speak Dutch or English

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
 

Within the EHS team, the Safety Advisor is part of the Internal Service for Prevention and Protection at Work and reports directly to the EHS Manager. The Safety Advisor works with fellow safety advisors to help create a safe and healthy ELC for teammates and external partners. This role collaborates closely with departments across the business, especially the Distribution Directors of the Distribution Centers (DCs) in Ham or Laakdal. The Safety Advisor also partners with DC teams and CPBW members to support continuous improvement in safety and health.
 

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON
 

You will help protect the well-being of teammates and external partners by advising the employer and managers on safety and health. You will assess workstations and distribution activities, map risks, investigate hazards where needed, and translate findings into practical advice.
 

You will support new installations and processes by providing managers with commissioning reports that are clear, timely, and actionable.
 

You will strengthen prevention by supporting incident and accident investigations, identifying root causes, and proposing measures that help prevent recurrence.
 

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 

Within the Nike ELC, Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) is looking for a Safety Advisor. This role is part of the Internal Service for Prevention and Protection at Work and supports the employer in creating safe, healthy working conditions for teammates and external partners, in line with Belgian Welfare Legislation.
 

 
 

Your Baseline to Play at Pro Level:
 
 

•  

Safety Expertise. Level 1 certification preferred, or at least three years of hands-on experience at Level 2.
  

•  

Belgian Welfare Legislation Knowledge. Knowledge of, or experience with, Belgian welfare and workplace safety legislation.
  

•  

Collaboration Skills. Ability to work effectively with operational teams, managers, CPBW members, and stakeholders across the business.
  

•  

Independent Working Style. Able to work independently, manage priorities, and connect the right partners when follow-up is needed.
  

•  

Language Proficiency. Fluent in Dutch and English, with clear written and verbal communication skills.
   

 
 

As a plus:
 

Any one of the following can strengthen the profile:
 
 

•  

Machine Safety: Strong knowledge of machine safety principles and how to apply them in an operational environment.
  

•  

Technical Background. A technical secondary school degree, plus ideally experience in a fast-paced logistics environment.
  

•  

Ergonomic Knowledge. Ability to assess ergonomic risks and translate findings into clear, practical improvements.
   

 
 

Other Skills That Step Up Your Performance:
 
 

•  

Facilitation and Reporting Skills. Can facilitate discussions with diverse stakeholders and translate complex information into clear, structured reports.
  

•  

Work Schedule Flexibility. Available to occasionally support outside standard office hours when operational needs require it.
